idea-plugin.name: Retrofit API Swagger
idea-plugin.description:
Retrofit API Swagger is a professional tool for visualizing and managing your Android network layer. It provides a visual "Design Mode" similar to the Jetpack Navigation Editor, tailored for Retrofit APIs.

🚀 Key Features

  • Interactive Node Graph: Visualize your service-to-endpoint relationships with a draggable and zoomable canvas.
  • Dual View Modes: Toggle between a high-level visual graph and a detailed, searchable card list.
  • Deep Inspection: Automatically extracts annotations (including custom ones like @SupportCache), method signatures, and parameters.
  • Powerful Filters: Live search by path or method name, and filter by HTTP method or module scope.
  • Design Tools: Includes a floating design toolbar with a hand-pan tool, zoom controls, and fit-to-screen functionality.

🛠️ Built for Modern Android

  • Full support for Kotlin K2 mode.
  • Robust discovery in complex multi-module Gradle projects.
  • Themed UI that respects Darcula and Light modes.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.1.8

  • Reactive Architecture: Full refactoring to a decoupled reactive model (SOLID).
  • Zero-Freeze UI: Optimized rendering pipeline eliminates IDE thread blocking during interaction.
  • Design View: Integrated Split Editor for side-by-side code and visual API management.
  • Native Progress: Scanning progress now integrated with the IDE status bar.
  • Reliability: Stable signatures for endpoints and improved mouse interaction models.
